name: lonetale
description: LoneTale - plataforma web de aventuras solo de RPG narrativo (ecossistema TavernTale)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @lonetale/engine && npm run build -w @lonetale/api && npm run build -w @lonetale/web
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @lonetale/engine && npm run build -w @lonetale/web
scripts.dev:preview: npm run build:engine && npm run start -w @lonetale/preview-server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:engine && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
